title: An empty `event_types` list is an in-band sentinel meaning "all events"

title: An endpoint can be created but never deactivated, deleted, or rotated
what_is_wrong: `active` is written as a literal `True` at creation and no route in the change ever mutates it, and there is no delete route and no secret-rotation route, so the `active` column and the "endpoint lifecycle" it implies have no writer.

title: Customer-supplied URL is validated by prefix and followed through redirects (SSRF)
what_is_wrong: The check is `parsed.scheme.startswith("http")`, which is surface-form adjudication rather than resolution — it admits `http://` cleartext and any scheme merely spelled with that prefix — and there is no check that the host resolves outside the internal network, while the delivery client is constructed with `follow_redirects=True` so even a validated public host can bounce the request to an internal one.

title: `_acquire_lock` is a non-atomic check-then-set, and its TTL is shorter than a batch
